summary: Comprehensive testing of Cash Flow Engine Phase 2 - Prepayment System. All backend APIs (100%) and frontend features (100%) verified working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cash Flow Phase 2 Prepayment System fully implemented and tested. All endpoints working: GET /api/expenses/by-month, POST /api/expenses/{id}/mark-paid, POST /api/expenses/{id}/prepay. Frontend MyExpenses page correctly shows month selector, summary with paid/pending totals, progress bar, and action buttons only for pending expenses.

backend_get_expenses_by_month.details: GET /api/expenses/by-month?month=YYYY-MM returns expenses with _displayStatus (paid/pending/prepaid). Defaults to current month when param not provided.

backend_mark_expense_paid.details: POST /api/expenses/{id}/mark-paid successfully marks expense as paid and sets paidDate, lastPaidDate, isPaid=true

backend_prepay_expense.details: POST /api/expenses/{id}/prepay creates prepaid record for next month with correct expenseMonth, prepaidFlag, linkedPaymentId

backend_no_route_conflict.details: GET /api/expenses/{expense_id} works correctly without conflicting with /by-month route

backend_double_prepay_prevention.details: POST /api/expenses/{id}/prepay returns 400 'Already prepaid for next month' when attempting duplicate prepay

frontend_month_selector.details: Month selector with left/right arrows navigates between months (prev -2 to next +3). Shows 'Current Month', 'Next Month' labels.

frontend_month_summary.details: Month summary card shows correct totals: total expenses (₹1.65 L), Paid/Prepaid (₹38.4 K, 5 expenses), Pending (₹1.26 L, 18 expenses), progress bar (23% settled)

frontend_expense_cards_buttons.details: Pending expenses show 'Mark Paid' and 'Prepay Next Month' buttons. Paid expenses show NO action buttons.

frontend_mark_paid_action.details: Clicking 'Mark Paid' button updates expense status to 'Paid' badge and shows success toast

frontend_prepay_action.details: Clicking 'Prepay Next Month' shows success toast 'Groceries prepaid for March 2026' and updates UI

frontend_paid_expenses_no_buttons.details: Already paid/prepaid expenses (Rent, Society Maintenance, Electricity Bill, Internet + Mobile, Gas Cylinder) do NOT show action buttons
